say:3:1010501001:0.text: There are too many guards... We'll have to find another way in.
say:3:1010501001:0.source_cn: 不行啊……守卫还是很多，找别的路吧。

say:4:1010501002:0.text: You noticed it too, right, Magister? On top of all the guards, there's also a magical barrier protecting this place.
say:4:1010501002:0.source_cn: 主人，你肯定发现了，庄园外不仅有卫兵把守，甚至还被一层...
say:4:1010501002:0.male: You noticed it too, right, Magister? On top of all the guards, there's also a magical barrier protecting this place.
say:4:1010501002:0.female: You noticed it too, right, Magister? On top of all the guards, there's also a magical barrier protecting this place.

say:5:1010501003:0.text: Which means Lord Franz is working with mages!
say:5:1010501003:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨果然和魔法师有勾结！
say:5:1010501003:0.male: Which means Lord Franz is working with mages!
say:5:1010501003:0.female: Which means Lord Franz is working with mages!

say:6:1010501004:0.text: Could there be another way to get in from the back of the manor? Yeah! Maybe around the back?
say:6:1010501004:0.source_cn: 我们能不能绕个大圈，从后边潜入庄园？

say:7:1010501005:0.text: I'm fairly familiar with the surrounding area, and there's only one way in.
say:7:1010501005:0.source_cn: 我对附近很熟，只有这一条路。

say:10:1010501006:0.text: Wait, I can hear people speaking underground. Hmm? It's coming from below us... Could there be underground dwellers here, too?
say:10:1010501006:0.source_cn: 不对，我能听见地下有人在说话。\n嗯？地下……？这里还...

say:11:1010501007:0.text: Wait, I just remembered! Lord Franz was boasting about some kind of secret passage he had installed in his manor. An escape tunnel of sorts.
say:11:1010501007:0.source_cn: ——我想起来了！弗朗茨曾经吹嘘过，他在庄园里设了几条密...

say:12:1010501008:0.text: Nobles do tend to build hidden passages like this in their homes. I have one as well.
say:12:1010501008:0.source_cn: 贵族宅邸一般都会有几个秘密出口，我的行馆也有。

say:13:1010501009:0.text: Ah, I wouldn't know anything about that since I'm not a noble.
say:13:1010501009:0.source_cn: 呵，不是贵族，没有这方面经验，真是抱歉。

say:14:1010501010:0.text: But can you hear down there, bunny-ears?
say:14:1010501010:0.source_cn: 兔耳朵，你能听出密道入口在哪吗？

say:15:1010501011:0.text: Hmm... Ugh, it's no use. The barrier is preventing me from hearing anything.
say:15:1010501011:0.source_cn: 呃……不行……都怪那层魔法壁垒，我根本听不清楚方位。

say:16:1010501012:0.text: Looks like I'll need the <style="highlight">wind</style> to help me with this.

say:17:1010501013:0.text: The wind? How's that going to help you?

say:18:1010501014:0.text: Did I forget to mention it? Aside from my excellent hearing, I'm also a <style="highlight">Windwhisperer</style>.
say:18:1010501014:0.source_cn: 我从没说过吗？我可不止耳朵好使，还是一名<style=...

say:21:1010501015:0.text: A Windwhisperer? I've heard of them. Only a small number of forest dwellers can command that kind of power.
say:21:1010501015:0.source_cn: 风语者？我知道，只有极少数森林的住民才能掌握这种能力。

say:22:1010501016:0.text: It's just as the name implies. Windwhisperers are capable of using the wind to communicate.
say:22:1010501016:0.source_cn: 正如其名，风语者可以和风沟通。

say:23:1010501017:0.text: You really are a learned individual, Miss Cassadee.
say:23:1010501017:0.source_cn: 不愧是博学多识的科丝蒂小姐。

say:24:1010501018:0.text: Yes, with this power, I can ask the wind to guide us through our current predicament.
say:24:1010501018:0.source_cn: 是的，接下来，我要使用魔法，和风对话，请它指引我们走出...
